purpose: Teach: 馳せ/繰り出し/ベター/つぶす/まわす/喰い/飛び込む/おこない

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんと子供時代に思いを馳せましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's look back on your childhood together, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, inviting tone. A soft opening. She's drawing him into a shared memory, not commanding. Warm pause before the second clause.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祭りの繰り出しの行列が見たいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to see the festival parade.
lines.style: Bright and direct. Quick energy, the eagerness of a small boy stating his wish simply. No apology, no hedging. Pure wanting.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きは練習を続けるのがベターよ
lines.en: Sho, you should keep practicing your drawing. That's what matters.
lines.style: Steady, caring counsel. Not bossy — more like she's sharing something she knows to be true. Slight emphasis on 「practice」 as the real work.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お絵描きを一気につぶす勢いだった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was almost crushing it all at once back then.
lines.style: Quiet, self-aware observation. Small laugh hidden underneath — he's not complaining, more noticing something about himself from a distance. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、傘をまわすと水滴が飛ぶから注意ね
lines.en: Sho, be careful when you spin an umbrella — the water sprays everywhere.
lines.style: Protective, practical advice delivered with warmth. Not scolding — she's already seen this happen. A gentle caution, the tone of someone who looks ahead.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんがおやつを喰い気味に勧めてくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa was really encouraging me to eat snacks back then.
lines.style: Affectionate memory, almost grateful. His voice lifts slightly when he says 「Grandpa」. He's treasuring the detail. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お絵描きの新分野に飛び込むのは怖くないわね
lines.en: Sho, you're not afraid to dive into new kinds of art, are you?
lines.style: Warm question, almost rhetorical. She knows the answer — she's affirming something she sees in him. Slight lilt of confidence at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、おこないを気を付けるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'll be more careful with what I do.
lines.style: Sincere, settling closure. He means it — not performing seriousness, but arriving at it. Quiet conviction. A small boy becoming more thoughtful.
